slides.title: The big idea
slides.html:
If two figures are similar with scale factor k, the ratio of their perimeters is k and the ratio of their areas is k2.

Every length is multiplied by k, so perimeters are too. A unit square becomes a k by k square, area k2; the same holds for triangles (base and height both multiply by k) and so for every polygon. Double every side and the area quadruples; triple every side and the area is 9 times as large.
